source.behavior: Open the module-level Site Email Settings surface for the authenticated active tenant, enumerate only tenant-visible sites, and optionally load the selected tenant-owned site's persisted email-recipient state without exposing protected SMTP/password material.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The explicit module GET route executes SiteEmailSettingsController::module, authorizes the active tenant member, reads the tenant-scoped site collection, optionally resolves a selected site through the tenant-scoped model, rereads persisted recipients, and renders the real site email settings view.

runtime_path: tenant-scoped Site list and optional Site::findOrFail(requestedSite)

authorization.guest_semantics: redirect to canonical login before tenant-owned data is rendered
authorization.direct_id_semantics: the optional caller-supplied numeric site query value is resolved under active TenantContext; foreign-tenant site IDs return 404

tenant_isolation.server_derived_ownership: TenantContext is established from the authenticated active membership; controller verifies the route tenant slug and Site/SiteEmailRecipient reads remain tenant-scoped.
tenant_isolation.idor_proof: Focused acceptance creates Alpha and Beta tenant data and proves Alpha cannot select Beta through either a foreign tenant route or a foreign optional site query ID, while Beta site and recipient data are absent from the Alpha response.

read_and_failure_semantics.authoritative_reread: Each GET rereads the tenant-scoped site collection and, when selected, the persisted site recipient list.
read_and_failure_semantics.truthful_success: 200 is asserted only after the guarded controller resolves the active tenant context and renders authoritative persisted tenant data.
read_and_failure_semantics.retry: safe; GET is read-only and repeatable
read_and_failure_semantics.cancellation: not applicable to synchronous read route

csrf_and_mutation_boundary.selected_operation: GET only; no CSRF-bearing server mutation is introduced.
csrf_and_mutation_boundary.existing_recipient_mutation: POST /tenants/{tenant}/sites/{site}/email-settings/recipients remains the separate canonical operation exposed by SiteEmailRecipientService::ADD_OPERATION_ID and the Blade form retains @csrf.

secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.smtp_secret_non_exposure: The module route/controller do not return password ciphertext or SMTP/provider secret fields; focused response acceptance checks common secret markers are absent.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.provider_calls: No email-provider send/test call is performed by this route operation.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.wordpress_connector: No WordPress or Connector call is performed by this route operation.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.ai_provider: No AI-provider call or secret is touched.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.queue_cache_scheduler: No queue, cache, scheduler, or background job side effect is introduced.

terminality.basis: A real guarded Laravel module route is explicitly operation-bound and proven to preserve authenticated tenant isolation, permission checks, authoritative persisted reads, foreign-site rejection, read-only semantics, separate CSRF-protected mutations, and secret/provider boundaries.
